Here is the issue description:
# Values for MVENDORID, MARCHID and MIMPID
The values of  `MVENDORID`, `MARCHID` and `MIMPID` are currently as-cloned from IBEX.  The will need to be updated to match the CVE2 values.  A good example of these can be found in the CV32E40X User Manual ([link](https://docs.openhwgroup.org/projects/cv32e40x-user-manual/en/latest/control_status_registers.html#machine-vendor-id-mvendorid)).

<analysis>
The issue highlights that the default CSR values for MVENDORID, MARCHID and MIMPID in cve2_pkg.sv still reflect the original Ibex settings and must be updated to the CVE2-assigned values. These three constants are defined as localparams in the CSR section of the package. To resolve the issue you should:

1. Inspect the CSR enumeration lines (364–369) to ensure the CSR numbers for MVENDORID, MARCHID, and MIMPID are correct per CVE2.
2. Update the localparam definitions at lines 559 (MVENDORID), 565 (MARCHID), and 571 (MIMPID) to the new CVE2 values.
3. (Optionally) Revise the comments immediately preceding these definitions (lines ~557–558) to document the updated CVE2 assignments.
